name: Azure Login
description: Authenticate to Azure and run your Azure CLI or Azure PowerShell based actions or scripts.

creds.description: Paste output of `az ad sp create-for-rbac` as value of secret variable: AZURE_CREDENTIALS

client-id.description: ClientId of the Azure Service principal created.

tenant-id.description: TenantId of the Azure Service principal created.

enable-AzPSSession.description: Set this value to true to enable Azure PowerShell Login in addition to Azure CLI login

environment.description: Name of the environment. Supported values are azurecloud, azurestack, azureusgovernment, azurechinacloud, azuregermancloud. Default being azurecloud

allow-no-subscriptions.description: Set this value to true to enable support for accessing tenants without subscriptions

audience.description: Provide audience field for access-token. Default value is api://AzureADTokenExchange

auth-type.description: The type of authentication. Supported values are SERVICE_PRINCIPAL, IDENTITY. Default value is SERVICE_PRINCIPAL
